results.title: Census 2026: Compulsory questionnaire sneaks up on Aussies, divides locals over new gender questions
results.description: From privacy conspiracy theories by the tinfoil hat brigade to allegations of a woke agenda, the Australian Bureau of Statistics’ five-yearly Census might be the nation’s most controversial questionnaire.

results.title: Nearly 20% of Israelis have considered emigrating in past two years, poll shows
results.description: Eighteen percent of Israelis have considered moving to another country over the past two years, and one-third of Israelis know at least one person who has emigrated within that timeframe, according to a Kan public broadcaster poll
